q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT DISTINCT P1.EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON P1 JOIN PERSON P2 ON P1.ID != P2.ID AND P1.EMAIL = P2.EMAIL

explanation: Q1 groups the records by email and checks if the count of emails in each group is greater than 1, which will return all emails that appear more than once in the table. Q2, on the other hand, uses a join to find distinct pairs of records with the same email but different IDs, which will return all unique emails that have at least one duplicate.
